content: {"episode_id":"ep-05014","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial for CPT 93229 based on the documented clinical indication, acknowledging that prior authorization was missing. The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias. Given the patient's personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, continuous mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to detect intermittent rhythm disturbances and guide appropriate anticoagulation and rate control management."}
